verdict.rationale: Preventing customer data from being used for AI model training is a fair privacy question for an AI-driven bookkeeping SaaS, so the axis applies. The pack contains no training opt-out, no no-training commitment and no data-usage policy for AI. The security doc covers only TLS/AES-256 encryption and Plaid credential handling, and role-based access control is an adjacent control, not a training opt-out. The categorization AI "learns from your changes," but nothing says whether that data trains models or can be excluded.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
